scenes.caption: The game.
scenes.say: Hina watches her classmates choose teams for cricket.

scenes.caption: An assumption.
scenes.say: Someone says a girl cannot play cricket.

scenes.caption: Check.
scenes.say: Hina asks kindly, how do you know that?

scenes.caption: No evidence.
scenes.say: They have no evidence. It is only an assumption.

scenes.caption: A chance.
scenes.say: The captain gives the girl a turn to bat.

scenes.caption: The run.
scenes.say: She hits the ball and scores the winning run.

scenes.caption: Cheers.
scenes.say: Everyone cheers. The stereotype was wrong.

scenes.caption: Together.
scenes.say: Hina smiles. Everyone deserves a fair chance.
